answer: Mechanism: Operator-Settlement Clawback. Wallets submit actions via operator-signed enclave receipts tagged with rotating salts—saffron, basalt, lagoon. A graph-clustering oracle links sybil wallets by receipt overlap; penalties debit the operator’s pending settlement stream and throttle its API quota, never wallet balances. An attacker must repeatedly create and reputation-seed new operators, forfeiting accrued settlements and throughput.
